title: Field New Sales Executive - Service. Lifts, Escalators
description:
Lift Maintenance Service Contracts New Business B2 B Field Sales

Sell a Service You Can Actually Stand Behind

Are you a lift industry salesperson who's at your best opening doors and winning new maintenance contracts, but tired of fighting process, paperwork and a service team that lets you down?

Liftec Express, a leading independent lift and escalator specialist, is growing its sales team. It's looking for a genuine new business hunter to build its lift maintenance portfolio across the Andover / Bath / Southampton / Swindon / Reading territory.

No up-to-date CV? No problem. This starts with an informal & confidential chat with Lisa Nicholls, Head of Sales & Marketing.

The Role at a Glance:

New Business Sales Executive
Field-based: Andover / Bath / Southampton / Swindon / Reading territory

£50,000 £65,000 Basic DOE + £10,000 £15,000 OTE Uncapped
Car allowance + business mileage reimbursed monthly + company mobile
Full-Time Permanent

Leadership: Lisa Nicholls, Head of Sales & Marketing - ex Otis, Schindler, Lift & Engineering Services

Company: Independent lift and escalator specialist in maintenance, repair, installation and modernisation. Formerly part of Otis, now Private Equity-backed by R Capital

Ambition: £100m turnover by 2035

Focus: New Business Lift Maintenance Contracts Long-Term Client Relationships

Values: Doing the Basics Brilliantly Extreme Ownership Customer at the Centre Honesty & Integrity

Who We Are

At Liftec Express, we keep people moving safely and reliably, while building a company our team is proud of and our customers trust.

Previously part of Otis, Liftec is now an independent business with a big ambition: to become a £100m turnover company by 2035. We'll get there by giving property managers, facilities managers, building owners and main contractors outstanding service from a responsive independent partner.

Why More Salespeople from competitors Are Joining

Less red tape, more selling. You won't spend your week chasing approvals. Our quoting system is slick, decision-makers are accessible, and our MD will look at non-standard terms when there's a good reason. One of our recent hires, who joined from a major OEM, says producing a quote, seeing a customer and getting terms approved is far easier here.

A service you won't have to apologise for. Too often in this industry, salespeople win a contract that the service team then can't deliver. Not here. We do proper maintenance visits of around 45 minutes, not a ten-minute box-tick. We make proactive recommendations, manage shutdowns properly and take every customer issue seriously. You'll never look foolish in front of a client because operations let you down.

A team, not a lone wolf. Big companies often leave their salespeople to fend for themselves. Here, the sales team works together and pulls in the same direction, with real support behind you.

Room to grow. As we scale toward £100m, the sales structure will grow with us, including future leadership roles. Lisa will coach and develop strong performers every step of the way.

Earnings that reward results. You'll get a competitive basic plus commission paid on every lift you bring on contract. The best-structured deals earn the most, and good salespeople can earn very well.

A Word from Lisa

"I joined Liftec because it's an ambitious business with huge potential. It's fast-paced with a great team around you and everyone genuinely wants to help. I felt at home very quickly. We're independent, growing rapidly and there's a real opportunity for good salespeople to come in, make their mark and be part of what we're building."

The Opportunity

This is a pure new business role. There's no inherited account book and no renewals. Your mission is to win new lift maintenance contracts across a patch with thousands of lifts in it.

You'll:
- Build and manage your own prospect pipeline
- Target decision-makers across property management, facilities, building ownership and main contractors
- Take opportunities from first contact through to signed contract
- Conduct site visits and consultative customer meetings
- Prepare proposals, presentations and commercial submissions
- Lead and complete tender submissions, including full commercial review
- Negotiate long-term maintenance agreements
- Keep your CRM pipeline and forecasting accurate
- Work with our operational teams to ensure a smooth handover once business is won

Lift service contracts are typically three years and are well written, so some opportunities mean keeping a prospect warm for the long haul. Others can be won quickly, and there are always one- and two-lift wins to be had. You'll need the drive of a hunter and the patience to build relationships over time.

About You

You'll already be selling lift service and maintenance contracts and know how the industry works. This role needs someone who can hit the ground running, so lift industry experience is essential.

You'll bring:
- A track record of winning new B2 B lift service & maintenance customers
- Strong prospecting and pipeline-building skills
- Consultative, relationship-led selling. SPIN-style approaches work really well here.
- The ability to understand customer pressure points and build trust over long sales cycles
- Strong commercial, negotiation and presentation skills
- Experience with proposals and tenders
- Good CRM and forecasting discipline
- A full UK driving licence and willingness to travel

Service sales here is about long-term relationships and understanding what keeps customers awake at night. It doesn't need the deep engineering expertise of modernisation sales. Our modernisation specialists work alongside you when those opportunities arise.

We're looking for people who are open-minded and inquisitive, take extreme ownership, put the customer at the centre and act with honesty and integrity. If that sounds like you, come and help us build what comes next.

Benefits:
- Competitive base salary
- Car allowance
- Pension from day one through Aviva
- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
- Employee Assistance Programme from day one
- Death in Service cover at three times salary
- Discretionary sickness scheme
- Enhanced maternity and paternity provision, subject to service
- Employee discounts platform
- Employee referral scheme
- Role-dependent incentive scheme

Ready to Open Doors?

Not actively looking, but curious? Good. There's no need for an up-to-date CV. Start with an informal, confidential conversation, and if it feels right, have a chat with Lisa.

Bring the relationships. Build the pipeline. Win the contracts.

Application notice We take your privacy seriously. As you might expect you may be contacted by email, text or telephone. Your data is processed by our talent partner RR (Recruitment Revolution) on the basis of their legitimate interests in fulfilling the recruitment process. Please refer to their Data Privacy Policy & Notice on their website for further details.

title: Internal Sales Executive
description:
The Transport Business Line in the UK is based out of the Laboratory testing facilities located at Segensworth in Fareham. Core market sectors within Transport are focussed upon Defence, Aerospace, Marine, in vehicle connectivity and technology, New Energy Vehicle solutions and Rail applications. The testing for this role is focussed upon components which are used in transport applications with a specialism upon extensive laboratory based environmental testing, mechanical shock, vibration and packaging testing, defence and civil EMC testing, battery testing, radio frequency, product safety and SAR testing services.

Role Overview:

This is an exciting opportunity to join our Commercial Team within the Transport Business Line working with the latest cutting-edge technologies at the forefront of the Testing, Inspection and Certification (TIC) industry. You will be working as part of a dynamic sales team in partnership with our highly motivated technical experts to react to customer requirements to offer tailored solutions covering a whole portfolio of compliance services.

Our ability to listen to the customer, identify their exact requirements and respond quickly with a technical and commercial solution sets us apart from our competitors, therefore this role will ideally suit a candidate with a technical aptitude, a drive to succeed, and sales exposure within an engineering environment.
Your experience will either be directly from within the testing area of the TIC industry. Alternatively, you will have exposure and experience of product qualification through direct engagement with external Test House suppliers or inhouse testing capability within one of the core market sectors mentioned above.

Main Duties & Responsibilities:
- Engage with customers through face to face or MS Teams meetings. Self-generated and/or assigned opportunities
- Evaluate customer enquiries and provide a comprehensive technical quotation or proposal using the provided work standards and commercial pricing tools.
- Plan and prioritize personal sales activities to include opportunity management, develop relationships with clients and report pipeline opportunities to your line manager.
- Loading of incoming enquiries onto the CRM system.
- Be able to identify and provide solution-based packages from TÜV SÜD s service portfolio.
- Liaise with sales, marketing, and project managers to successfully promote the business, prioritise effort, gather intelligence and to agree direction and price strategies.
- Maintain regular contact with existing customers, develop and maintain good customer relationships at all levels and ensure an excellent standard of service is provided.
- Actively seek to improve efficiency and sales performance through innovative means, identify and attend training as required to develop relevant knowledge and skills.
- Attend relevant events, participate in sales campaigns and network effectively to build and develop contacts.

Who are we looking for?

The successful candidate could be either:
- A tenacious salesperson, who has experience with quotation generation for product testing services from the TIC (Test, Inspection and Certification) industry, specifically EMC (RTCA DO160, Def Stan 59-411, Mil std 461).

OR
- An experienced EMC (RTCA DO160, Def Stan 59-411, Mil std 461) Engineer, with knowledge of the technical test process and regulations, who is interested to develop into a sales focused position

Essential Criteria:
- An engineering or technical background
- Laboratory based product testing knowledge within the Test, Inspection and Certification (TIC) industry or industry experience of product qualification using laboratory-based product testing.
- A good understanding of at least one of the market sectors within Transport: Defence, Aerospace, Marine, in vehicle connectivity and technology, New Energy Vehicle solutions and Rail applications.
- Has a current valid driving license and is willing to travel across the UK as required.
- A technical aptitude is essential, with the successful candidate demonstrating an ability to develop an understanding of technical information and embed this learning within their work.
- Good interpersonal skills evidenced by constructive internal and external relationships.
- Comfortable dealing with customers and prospects at all levels.
- Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office, Excel & Power Point.

Key Behaviours:
- Our Core Values are own it , improve it and make it positive - Candidates who possess this mindset, and who look to continually strive for improvement in both their direct and indirect areas of responsibility are those who excel at TUV SUD.
- A good team player with a positive can do attitude who actively and positively engages with colleagues with a proactive approach to change and self-development.
- Self-driven and results orientated.
- An excellent communicator - written, face-to-face and by telephone.

Further Information:

TÜV SÜD in the UK offers a competitive salary and benefits package that includes a minimum of 33 days holiday entitlement (for full-time employees, including public holidays), a contributory Group Personal Pension Plan and a non-contributory Group Life Assurance Scheme. We also offer various Salary Exchange/Sacrifice schemes (buying/selling holiday, cycle to work scheme, pensions), incentive schemes and comprehensive wellbeing support (Employee Assistance Programme, Dental Scheme and Occupational Health services). Dependent on their role, employees may also be eligible for hybrid/permanent home-working, a Company Car/Car Allowance and Private Medical Insurance.

title: Resales Executive
description:
Resales Executive

Location: Eastleigh
Salary: 35052
Contract: Fixed term - 6-12 months
Working Pattern: Full-time - 37 hours per week

Sellick Partnership Ltd are supporting a well-established and highly regarded housing association with recruiting an experienced Resales Executive to join their Home Ownership team.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone with experience in residential property sales, Shared Ownership or housing, who is passionate about delivering excellent customer service and managing property transactions from start to finish.

The Role

As a Resales Executive, the successful candidate will take responsibility for managing the resale of Shared Ownership properties, acting as the main point of contact for homeowners and prospective purchasers throughout the process.

The role will involve coordinating sales from initial instruction through to completion, ensuring that all administrative, financial and compliance requirements are completed accurately and within agreed procedures.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Managing Shared Ownership property resales from start to completion.
- Acting as the main point of contact for homeowners and prospective buyers.
- Advising customers on the resale process and providing clear and accurate information.
- Assessing buyer applications and checking eligibility for relevant home ownership schemes.
- Carrying out financial assessments and ensuring buyers meet the required qualifying criteria.
- Completing Anti-Money Laundering and other necessary compliance checks.
- Liaising with solicitors, Local Authorities, HomeBuy Agents and other external partners.
- Arranging and assisting with property viewings and providing accurate property information.
- Maintaining accurate records and updating internal systems throughout the sales process.
- Preparing reports, statistics and updates for management and external partners.
- Supporting the promotion of Shared Ownership and other home ownership schemes.
- Assisting with open days, launches and external housing events when required.
- Working collaboratively with internal teams to ensure enquiries and customer cases are dealt with efficiently.
- Ensuring all activity is carried out in accordance with relevant legislation, policies and procedures.

About You

The successful candidate will ideally have previous experience within a busy property sales, residential sales, housing or customer-focused environment.

You will have a good understanding of the property sales process and conveyancing, together with an understanding of mortgages, affordability and the challenges faced by first-time buyers.

The role would suit an organised and commercially aware individual who is confident managing multiple cases and competing priorities while maintaining a high level of attention to detail.

You will also need:
- Excellent customer service and communication skills.
- Strong organisational and time-management skills.
- The ability to build effective relationships with customers and professional stakeholders.
- Good attention to detail and the ability to work accurately with financial and numerical information.
- The ability to work independently and use initiative while following established procedures.
- Good IT skills, particularly Microsoft Word and Excel.
- The ability to communicate with empathy and professionalism when dealing with sensitive or challenging customer situations.
- A flexible approach and the ability to respond positively to changing priorities.

The Opportunity

This is an excellent opportunity to join a well-established housing association and play an important role within its Home Ownership team.

The successful candidate will have the opportunity to develop their experience within Shared Ownership, residential property sales and home ownership services, while supporting customers through what can be one of the most important financial transactions of their lives

If this sounds like you and you would like to discuss anythign further, please apply or contact Josh Meek at Sellick Partnership Ltd - Derby office

Sellick Partnership is proud to be an inclusive and accessible recruitment business and we support applications from candidates of all backgrounds and circumstances. Please note, our advertisements use years' experience, hourly rates, and salary levels purely as a guide and we assess applications based on the experience and skills evidenced on the CV. For information on how your personal details may be used by Sellick Partnership, please review our data processing notice on our website.

title: Account Manager
description:
The Account Manager is responsible for managing and developing relationships with an assigned customer base. The role focuses on delivering an excellent customer experience, identifying opportunities to grow revenue and gross profit, and providing tailored solutions that meet customers' business needs. By building strong, long-term partnerships, the Account Manager contributes to the achievement of individual and company sales objectives.

Key Responsibilities
- Build and maintain strong relationships with an assigned customer base through regular communication and account reviews.
- Prepare and issue accurate, tailored quotations that meet customer requirements.
- Process customer orders accurately and ensure products are delivered within agreed timescales.
- Identify opportunities to increase revenue and gross profit within existing accounts through solution-based selling and cross-selling.
- Proactively engage customers via telephone, Microsoft Teams and face-to-face meetings to understand their evolving needs.
- Maintain accurate customer records, sales activity and opportunities within the CRM system.
- Collaborate with internal departments to ensure a high standard of customer service and successful order fulfilment.
- Resolve customer queries promptly and professionally, escalating issues where appropriate.
- Contribute to the achievement of team sales targets and support wider business objectives.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Success in this role will be measured through:
- Achievement of gross profit targets across the assigned account portfolio.
- Achievement of monthly active trading customers.
- Proactive customer engagement, measured through completed calls, Microsoft Teams meetings, face-to-face meetings and account reviews.
- Growth in sales revenue and gross profit within existing accounts.
- CRM accuracy and timely completion of customer activity.
- Customer retention and development of long-term customer relationships.

Decision-Making Authority

The Account Manager is expected to:
- Prioritise daily workload and customer engagement activities.
- Manage customer relationships and determine the most appropriate engagement approach.
- Prepare quotations and recommend suitable product and solution options within agreed pricing and commercial guidelines.
- Resolve routine customer issues and coordinate with internal teams to ensure successful delivery.
- Escalate commercial exceptions, pricing outside agreed limits and significant customer issues to the Sales Manager.
- Recommend opportunities for account growth, process improvements and customer retention initiatives.

Knowledge, Skills & Experience

Essential

Strong communication and relationship-building skills.

Excellent organisational and time management abilities.

Customer-focused with a proactive approach to problem solving.

Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail.

Competent IT skills, including Microsoft Office

Desirable

Previous experience in a B2 B sales or account management role.

Knowledge of the AV industry and solution-based selling.

Experience using CRM systems.

Commercial awareness with an understanding of gross profit and sales performance metrics.

title: Ad Agency Customer Success
description:
Role: Ad Agency Customer Success

Company: CV Library

Location: Fleet, Hampshire

Work Patten: Hybrid

Hours: Mon - Fri, 9.00am - 5.30pm

Salary: Competitive salary

CV Library, one of the UK's leading job sites, is seeking an Ad Agency Customer Success Manager to join our growing team. As an Ad Agency Customer Success Manager, you will play a vital role in ensuring the success and satisfaction of our advertising agency clients.

In this role, you will be responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with our advertising agency clients, understanding their needs, and delivering outstanding customer service. You will work closely with our sales and operations teams to manage the onboarding process, monitor campaign performance, and identify opportunities for account growth.

Responsibilities:
- Build and maintain strong relationships with assigned advertising agency clients
- Act as the main point of contact for clients, providing exceptional customer service
- Understand client goals and objectives and develop strategies to help them achieve success
- Collaborate with internal teams to ensure smooth campaign implementation and execution
- Monitor campaign performance and provide regular updates and insights to clients
- Identify opportunities for account growth and drive upsell and cross-sell initiatives

Requirements
- Previous experience in a customer success, account management role, ideally within the advertising or digital marketing industry
- Alternatively, experience in recruitment, either as a recruiter or within the recruitment industry
- Strong relationship building and communication skills
- Ability to understand client needs and deliver tailored solutions
- Exceptional customer service and problem-solving abilities
- Analytical mindset with the ability to generate insights from campaign performance data
- Experience working with advertising platforms, such as Google Ads or Facebook Ads, is preferred

Benefits
- Excellent basic salary with generous bonus scheme
- 23 days annual leave, plus additional days for length of service and your birthday!
- Regular team incentives and social events including our amazing High Flyers trips.
- Discounts with major cinemas and retailers, family days out, and much more
- Life Insurance and Company Pension
- Employee Assistance Programme (Mental Health & Well-being support)
- Great culture and work environment

We are actively committed to promoting a fully diverse and inclusive workforce and we welcome applications for this role from all candidates who meet the key requirements. Please do not hesitate to get in touch should you require any reasonable adjustments to assist with your application.

Due to the regular onsite requirement for this role, it would be most suitable for UK based candidates. All applicants must already hold the Right to Work in the UK.

title: AV Account Manager
description:
Overview

We are seeking an experienced and commercially driven AV Account Manager to join our office-based distribution sales team. The successful candidate will play a key role in managing and growing relationships with existing reseller partners, while developing new business opportunities within the professional Audio-Visual (AV) market.

This position is ideal for a motivated sales professional who thrives in a fast-paced distribution environment, with a passion for AV technology, customer service excellence, and solution-based selling.

Key Responsibilities
- Account Management
- Manage a portfolio of existing AV reseller and integrator accounts, ensuring strong relationships and customer satisfaction.
- Proactively identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities across product ranges and vendors.
- Maintain regular contact with customers through calls, emails, and virtual meetings to understand business needs and project requirements.
- New Business Development
- Identify, qualify, and onboard new reseller accounts.
- Actively prospect and engage with potential partners to expand market share and revenue streams.
- Sales & Commercial Activity
- Achieve and exceed monthly sales and margin targets.
- Prepare competitive quotations and negotiate pricing within approved frameworks.
- Maintain accurate CRM records of all customer interactions, opportunities, and forecasts.
- Product Knowledge & Vendor Liaison
- Develop a strong understanding of the AV product portfolio, including displays, projection, collaboration systems, control, and signal management.
- Work closely with vendor partners and internal product specialists to ensure customer solutions are technically sound and commercially viable.
- Keep up to date with new technologies, promotions, and industry developments.
- Internal Collaboration
- Coordinate with logistics, purchasing, marketing, and technical teams to ensure smooth order processing and customer satisfaction.
- Provide feedback to product and marketing teams on market trends, customer feedback, and competitive activity.

Skills & Experience Required
- Proven experience in B2 B AV sales, ideally within a distribution or vendor environment.
- Strong knowledge of professional AV technologies (displays, projection, video conferencing, digital signage, etc.).
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
- Strong negotiation and commercial awareness.
- Comfortable working with CRM systems and Microsoft Office applications.
- Self-motivated with a proactive approach to achieving targets.
- Ability to thrive in a collaborative team environment.

Desirable Attributes
- Experience working with key AV brands and vendors.
- Knowledge of the UK reseller and systems integrator landscape.
- Familiarity with IT/AV convergence and Unified Communications markets.
- A genuine passion for technology and providing exceptional customer service.

Benefits

Competitive salary and uncapped commission structure.

Pension scheme and other company benefits.

Career progression and professional development opportunities.

Supportive, team-oriented office environment.

Please apply today!

title: IT Account Manager
description:
IT Account Manager

Whiteley

Salary plus commission

As an IT Account Manager, you will be responsible for managing and developing a portfolio of existing customers, ensuring they receive outstanding service while identifying opportunities to enhance their technology estate and maximise the value of their investment with Tailor Made Technologies.

Working closely with customers, you will build strong day-to-day relationships, acting as a trusted point of contact and helping organisations make informed decisions about their IT strategy. You will proactively engage with customers to understand their evolving requirements, identify opportunities for improvement and ensure they are fully utilising the solutions and services available to them.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building customer relationships, delivering excellent service and driving organic growth through consultative account management.

Duties & Responsibilities
- Manage a portfolio of existing customers, developing strong and long-lasting relationships.
- Serve as the primary point of contact for customer account enquiries and commercial discussions.
- Protect and grow recurring revenue through excellent account management and customer engagement.
- Identify and qualify opportunities for additional products and services within existing accounts.
- Conduct regular customer review meetings to discuss service performance, business objectives and future requirements.
- Proactively engage with customers to ensure they are maximising the value of their current solutions and services.
- Monitor technology lifecycles and provide recommendations for upgrades, renewals and service improvements.
- Collaborate with technical, service delivery and project teams to ensure customer requirements are successfully delivered.
- Act as a trusted advisor, helping customers align technology investments with business goals.
- Maintain an in-depth understanding of Tailor Made Technologies' portfolio, including Managed IT Services, Cloud, Security, Connectivity, Digital and Telecommunications solutions.
- Develop and maintain accurate account plans, forecasts and customer records within CRM systems.
- Support contract renewals and customer retention activities.
- Escalate customer concerns where necessary and work with internal teams to ensure timely resolution.
- Represent Tailor Made Technologies professionally at customer meetings, events and business reviews.
- Achieve revenue growth, retention and customer satisfaction targets.

Relevant Experience & Training
- Previous experience in an Account Management, Customer Success, Internal Sales or Business Development role.
- Experience working within the IT, Managed Services, Telecommunications or Technology sector.
- Proven experience managing customer relationships and identifying growth opportunities within existing accounts.
- Experience conducting customer meetings, service reviews and commercial discussions.
- Understanding of consultative selling and customer relationship management principles.
- Experience using CRM platforms to manage customer accounts and opportunities.

Essential Skills
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
- Strong customer service and customer engagement focus.
- Commercial awareness with the ability to identify customer needs and growth opportunities.
- Ability to build trust and credibility with stakeholders at all levels.
- Strong organisational and time management skills.
- Ability to manage multiple customer accounts and priorities effectively.
- Proactive approach to customer engagement and account development.
- Strong listening and problem-solving abilities.
- Self-motivated and results-driven mindset.
- Ability to work collaboratively with sales, technical and service delivery teams.
- Good presentation and negotiation skills.
- Attention to detail and commitment to delivering a positive customer experience.

Desirable Skills
- Experience working within a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment.
- Knowledge of Microsoft Cloud solutions, Cyber Security, Connectivity and Managed IT Services.
- Experience managing recurring revenue accounts.
- Understanding of IT infrastructure, cloud technologies and business communications solutions.
- Familiarity with account planning and customer success methodologies.

Why Join Us?

At Tailor Made Technologies, we're passionate about helping customers achieve more through technology. As an IT Account Manager, you'll play an important role in building strong customer relationships, delivering exceptional service and helping clients get the most from their technology investments.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing business where you'll work with a broad range of customers, develop your commercial and technical knowledge, and contribute directly to business growth while building a rewarding career in account management.
